items.title: New section skinning.md: per-addon skin via the LibKa0s Skin facade, Appearance tab, EllesmereUI provider carve-out, anti-pattern with leg-2 commencement; library-stack and options-ui ripple
items.issue_refs: OWNER_SCOPE R1-R8; 03_SPEC §1, §3, §4, §5, §7; inputs/LIBKA0S_INTERNALS.md §1 item 8 (library-stack.md:92 module table, :128 major count)
items.spec: Write a new standards section file named skinning (follow the existing section file shape, numbering §1.., index entry in STANDARDS.md Sections list placed sensibly, e.g. after frame-layering). Content (normative, MUST/SHOULD): (1) every visual element of an addon that has adopted skins paints through the LibKa0s Skin facade (LibKa0s-Skin-1.0) with the addon folder name as owner, registered at file load; (2) the skin choice is per addon, stored in the profile as appearance.source and appearance.skin (defaults "ka0s"/"ka0s"); (3) the Appearance tab on the General page, after Interface and before Keybindings, drawn by O.AppearanceTab; (4) the shipped skins list (nine keys) and that Ka0s Default reproduces the pre-skin look; (5) the EllesmereUI provider: gate conditions, the named read-only call-time read of EllesmereUIDB confined to LibKa0s/SkinEUI.lua as an explicit carve-out of library-stack-§6 / anti-pattern #29, reload rule eui->ka0s; (6) HUD style settings resolve through the FROM_SKIN sentinel, and on adoption an addon resets its saved HUD style values to the sentinel once (owner ruling R3); (7) never skin Blizzard shared frames (SettingsPanel, StaticPopup, GameTooltip, ColorPickerFrame), never leak through AceGUI pools, taint rules; (8) a new anti-pattern "hard-coded chrome color/font in an addon that has adopted skins", with a COMMENCEMENT note: binding for an addon once it adopts skins (LootHistory from this run; the other addons at their leg-2 rollout), so unconverted addons are not findings. Ripple: library-stack.md module table gains LibKa0s-Skin-1.0 and the "N of M majors floor on Core" count; options-ui General-tab order gains Appearance; anti-pattern list numbering; executive summary / context pack / AUDIT.md / NEW_ADDON*.md only where the repo's ripple rules say a new section must appear. Changelog entry lines.

items.spec: Download static TTFs from the official upstream sources (google/fonts GitHub ofl/ directories or the font projects' release pages); if only a variable font is available (Cinzel), produce a static SemiBold instance with fontTools (python3 -m fontTools.varLib.instancer) and note that in the license/readme. Add LSM "border" and "background" catalog registration for shipped textures: generate white rounded-corner nine-slice TGA(s) for Glass (radius 8, 32x32 or similar, power-of-two, uncompressed TGA with alpha) with a small python script kept in tools/ (document it), plus register the in-client keys the skins will use (e.g. Blizzard Dialog border/background) only if LSM does not already. Media minor bump; prune-icons.lua must not touch the new folders (verify). Tests: registration, masks, files exist, licenses present. README credits/licenses section and DEPENDENCIES.md (assets) updated.

items.issue_refs: OWNER_SCOPE R1-R4, R7; 03_SPEC §2, §3; inputs/LIBKA0S_INTERNALS.md; inputs/ACEGUI_AND_ENGINE_RESEARCH.md; token source inputs/mockup-tokens.dc.html (BASE/SKINS) and plan-data/mockups/skins-mockup.html
items.spec: Implement 03_SPEC §2 (token schema) and §3 (engine, minus primitives which are LK-04, minus EUI which is LK-05). Files: LibKa0s/Skin.lua (primary: NewLibrary("LibKa0s-Skin-1.0", 1), Core floor, MODULES, owner registry lib.owners, RegisterOwner/For/SetChoice/GetChoice/Resolve/Token/Color/OnLooksChanged scoped per owner, weak frame registry lib.painted + lib.byOwner, repaint loop, FROM_SKIN = "@skin", ResetToSkin(profile, keys)), LibKa0s/SkinDefs.lua (secondary paired on the shell's minor: RegisterSkin + the nine skins: ka0s, obsidian, azeroth, glass, contrast, ember, wow, midnight, forever, each with label, desc, 4 swatches, tokens). Ka0s Default token values MUST equal today's constants (inputs/LIBKA0S_INTERNALS.md §2 table and inputs/LOOTHISTORY_SURFACES.md §3); where two sites draw one role in different colors keep two tokens. Other skins translate the mockup tokens (CSS) into the schema faithfully; WoW Forever follows OWNER_SCOPE R4 (warm charcoal bg, black title bar with CENTER white title, tan accent ~#C9A07A, gold headings ~#F2B33D, thin borders, Barlow), WoW Default the vanilla look (Blizzard dialog border/background textures, red buttons with gold text), WoW Midnight night-blue/gold/violet. Fonts per 03_SPEC §2. LibKa0s.xml rows, tests/majors.lua row with paired entries, docs/api/Skin/version-<key>-docs.md (members, adopting it, token schema reference table listing every token and its Ka0s Default value), docs/api/README row, README module table, docs/releasing.md lists. Tests: every skin resolves every schema token; Ka0s Default equals the legacy constants (pin against lib.SKIN and the file-local tables); per-owner isolation (owner A switching never repaints B's frames); repaint calls each recorded frame once; FROM_SKIN resolve and ResetToSkin. CCN <= 15, files <= 1500 lines.

items.title: Ka0s primitives (SkinPaint): the EllesmereUI-compatible vocabulary plus Ka0s extras, idempotent, repaintable, recorded per owner
items.issue_refs: 03_SPEC §3 Facade; inputs/LIBKA0S_INTERNALS.md; inputs/ACEGUI_AND_ENGINE_RESEARCH.md (research §2 technique, §4 live repaint, §5 textures)
items.spec: Implement the facade primitives for source "ka0s" in one or more secondaries paired on the Skin shell (e.g. LibKa0s/SkinPaint.lua, SkinPaintControls.lua) so S = Skin:For(owner) exposes: Shell(frame, opts{noBorder,noTopBar,bottomBar}), Panel(frame, opts{inset,noBorder,noBg}), Inset, FadeRegions, FadeNineSlice, Button(btn, keepKeys | opts{primary}), WhiteButtonLabel, StateButtonLabel, EditBox(eb, opts{padInput,noBorder}), Checkbox(cb, opts{stockCheck,borderInset,hover}), Dropdown, ScrollBar, Tab, SetTabSelection, CloseButton, PageButton, SquareIcon, SortHeaderBar, Font(fs, r,g,b), White, ApplyBarFill, GetAccentColor, GetPanelColor, GetFont, OnLooksChanged, IsEnabled, GetStyle ("ka0s:<key>"), apiVersion = 3, and extras TitleBar, Divider, Footer, Card, Slider, NavItem, Drawer, ListRow(row, state), MenuFrame, Tooltip (library-owned frames), Strip, Cover, Text(fs, role), Token, Color, ChartStyle, BarStyle, IconBorder, GlowColor. Technique: stock art faded by alpha (prior values recorded), Ka0s regions created once per frame and kept in the weak record, never Hide/SetParent/SetScript on Blizzard frames, SetBackdrop only on frames the library or the owner created with BackdropTemplate, borders as 1px edge textures or nine-slice per the token, gradients via SetGradient, fonts via a per-owner FontObject then SetFont (12.0.7 shadow rule). Repaint re-applies colors/fonts/textures from the new skin on the recorded regions. Tests with the LK-01 recorder: each primitive paints from tokens, idempotent second call, repaint changes the recorded regions to the new skin, Ka0s Default output for Shell equals what Core.ApplySkin paints today.

items.title: EllesmereUI provider (SkinEUI): per-owner RegisterSkin, gate, pass-through + getter-based extras, fail-closed, reload rule; deviation register row
items.issue_refs: OWNER_SCOPE brief; 03_SPEC §5; ../PremadeGroupsFilterExtension/core/EUIBridge.lua, modules/EUISkin.lua, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md "EllesmereUI seams", its tests' EUI fake (m.installEUI); EllesmereUI SKINNING_API.md (read via "/mnt/g/Games/Blizzard/World of Warcraft/_retail_/Interface/AddOns/EllesmereUI/SKINNING_API.md"; describe, never copy code)
items.spec: Implement 03_SPEC §5 in LibKa0s/SkinEUI.lua (secondary on the Skin shell). RegisterOwner calls EllesmereUI.RegisterSkin(owner, cb) when present; cb stores the facade per owner and paints only while that owner's source is "eui" and the gate holds; shape check before any paint (refuse + latch + one log line if a needed primitive is missing); pcall the paint, fail closed. Skin:GetEUIStatus(owner) returns the three conditions with ok/label/hint for the Appearance tab. Switching ka0s->eui live: hide Ka0s overlays of the owner's recorded frames then run the EUI primitives; eui->ka0s: set pending-reload and fire a reload request callback (the tab shows the popup). Ka0s extras under eui paint from S.GetAccentColor/GetPanelColor/GetFont and follow S.OnLooksChanged. Add the documented-deviation row to LibKa0s CLAUDE.md register (library-stack-§6 / anti-pattern #29: read-only, call-time, nil-guarded reads of EllesmereUIDB.thirdPartySkinsOff and .thirdPartySkinAddons[owner], confined to SkinEUI.lua; Decided 2026-10-25 per the owner's brief and PGFE's 2026-10-09 ratification; re-check trigger: EllesmereUI publishes a query API that works before dispatch, or the read spreads to another file). Tests with a headless EllesmereUI fake (testkit or test-local), modeled on PGFE's: gate permutations, dispatch before/after login, per-owner isolation, shape refusal, fallback to Ka0s skin when gate fails.

items.title: AceGUI rows skinned per owner with restore-on-release (SkinAce): CheckBox, Slider, Dropdown + pull-out, EditBox, MultiLineEditBox, Button, Heading, Label, InteractiveLabel, Icon, ColorPicker swatch, InlineGroup, ScrollFrame
items.spec: Implement LibKa0s/SkinAce.lua (secondary on the Skin shell). OptionsWidgets (and the other makers that acquire AceGUI widgets) call Skin:PaintAce(owner, widget) right after acquiring when the page has an owner and that owner's skin is not ka0s (Ka0s Default = stock AceGUI as today, nothing painted). Fade stock regions by alpha and record prior alpha/font/colors/backdrop in the weak table; create overlays once per widget object (reuse on re-acquire); chain the widget's per-instance OnRelease (as OptionsScroll.lua does) to restore every recorded value and hide overlays; Dropdown pull-out painted on open for its owner, restored on close; guard every field (AceGUI version drift); step aside if ElvUI/AddOnSkins skinned the widget (detect their markers) . LSM30 pull-outs and ColorPickerFrame stay stock. Tests (headless AceGUI mocks; add what is missing to the LK-01 recorder via a further kit tweak only if needed, bumping the kit revision again only if testkit changes): owner A paints a CheckBox, releases it, owner B (or a non-Ka0s addon) acquires the same object and sees stock values; repaint on SetChoice; Ka0s Default paints nothing.

items.title: O.AppearanceTab: skin source (Ka0s / EllesmereUI with gate status), the nine-skin choice grid with swatches, copy to every Ka0s addon, reload popup

Selecting calls set() then Skin:SetChoice(owner, ...) for a live repaint; eui->ka0s shows a reload StaticPopup (owned popup spec, strata per frame-layering rules). Strings via the consumer locale pattern used by other O.* makers (library default English strings with override hook) - follow how OptionsKeybinds handles its intro text.
